notes.li: MF Vanilla 0.10.0 is a feature release focused on Chronomancy, Illusion, planar material purpose, and practical quality-of-life improvements.
Chronomancy now has a first playable identity. Temporal Resurrection can pull a dead pawn back through time, then slowly unwind wounds while skill memory is lost as the price of survival.
Borrowed Season adds a practical Chronomancy utility spell: target a field and pulse rapid crop growth through nearby plants.

Illusion now has Phantom Reinforcements, a decoy spell that conjures short-lived illusory allies. They draw hostile attention, vanish when struck, and avoid ordinary corpse, death, and mourning events.
Planar Magic gains clearer material purpose. Phase stone can now build walls that Arcane Gift pawns can pass through, while void glass walls provide durable illuminated planar construction.
The two current planar destinations now have names: the Aether Wild and Cinderdeep.
Cinderdeep now yields Cinder Rosebushes and Cinder Roses. Harvesting the thorny bush can draw blood, while the rose itself can be given as a meaningful gift.
Arcane ink crafting now accepts healroot as an alternative organic ingredient when exotic herbs are scarce.
The planar gate now properly belongs under Planar Magic research, and related icons, generated scrolls, lifecycle cleanup, and normal-play logging received polish.
MF Vanilla 0.9.0 is a feature release focused on advanced school identity, planar exploration, and release-candidate polish for the first-party content set.

Planar Magic now has a playable foundation: colonies can open planar gates, enter temporary pocket dimensions, gather strange materials, and return safely through the gate loop. Save and reload testing inside planar spaces passed during release smoke testing.

Forbidden Lore now has dangerous first spells. Dominate Will can temporarily compel a hostile humanlike pawn to fight as an ally, while Forbidden Plague spreads through clustered enemies until treated and overcome.
Vitalism gains Cure Disease, a maintained support spell that uses magical treatment instead of instantly deleting disease state.
Geomancy gains Dig and Earth Wall, giving earth magic practical mining and defensive battlefield tools.

The first Arcane Forge weapon set has been smoke tested: Zephyr Spear, Flaming Longsword, Tidebreaker Mace, and Stonefall Mace now provide validated activated powers, passives, protections, and melee triggers.
Spell and spell-scroll inspect text now uses the generated Magic Framework detail language correctly.
MF Vanilla 0.8.2 was a quality-of-life progression patch focused on making spell access and caster growth feel less bottlenecked.
Completing spell-unlocking arcane research now calls down mysterious aid: one matching spell scroll appears for the colony, giving each new school an immediate playable payoff.
Spell scrolls are easier to find through Elementalist traders and arcane treasure rewards, while scroll market value now scales with the depth of research needed to unlock the spell.
Gifted pawns now gain caster experience when learning spells from scrolls and when successfully casting spells they know.

Arcane Gift pawns can apprentice under higher-level gifted mentors while the mentor performs arcane research, scribing, alchemy, or enchantment work. Multiple apprentices can learn from the same mentor.
MF Vanilla 0.8.1 was a small quality-of-life patch: spell scroll recipes now clearly explain that the scribe must have the Arcane Gift and already know the spell being copied.
Manual work orders now give clearer failure reasons when a scribing or arcane forge job needs a gifted pawn, or when a scroll needs a scribe who knows the spell.
Magic passive coolers can now be minified like magic heaters, making magical temperature infrastructure easier to move during colony redesigns.
Arcane mission sites have gained additional decorative ruins and site dressing so caches, sanctums, and vaults have a stronger explored-place feel.
MF Vanilla 0.8 expands the world layer with natural arcane mission opportunities, including Arcane Cache, Ruined Sanctum, and Sealed Vault sites.
Arcane sites now use deterministic profile-driven layouts, reward chests, themed rooms, exterior ruins, mission letters, timeouts, and construct guardians.
Leyline Sensitivity now reveals a hidden leyline map, can show optional strength numbers, improves mana recovery near strong currents, and can empower Arcane Forge work near resonant currents.
Gifted pawns can now embrace Arcane Disciplines through a marker ritual, and discipline restrictions can guide spell learning for colonies that want specialization.
The elemental spell set has grown with Air Blast, Stoneskin, Extinguish, Deluge, Warmth, and sustained Heat, with scroll generation and research gates in place.

The magic economy remains fully playable: grow herbs, prepare papyrus or parchment, grind gemstone dust, brew arcane ink, scribe scrolls, cut gems, craft elemental foci, and build toward advanced enchantment.
Gifted pawns grow as spellcasters through arcane research, scribing, alchemy, and enchantment work, unlocking higher-level spells through play instead of dev tools.
Arcane treasure chests appear as magical reward caches, packed with scrolls, gems, silver, gold, enchanted prizes, rare materials, and other discoveries.
The Arcane Forge is ready for ambitious colonies, letting skilled enchanters transform quality weapons into elemental arms powered by linked arcane spires.

Enchanted weapons now have clearer identities: Zephyr Spear, Flaming Longsword, Tidebreaker Mace, and Stonefall Mace provide a mix of activated powers, passive protections, melee triggers, and elemental flavor.
Arcane constructs and automata now guard higher-value sites, including clay automata, rune-slashers, crystal sentinels, rune-ballista constructs, and the rare Deep Iron Golem.
Stay tuned: future updates are planned to add elemental cultures, advanced school identities, deeper arcane sites, and more magical world events.
